official_name: At One Fathom Bank (with precautionary area 'Off Port Klang')

tss_identity: Confirmed
Amended scheme adopted by MSC 69 (May 1998); COLREG.2/Circ.44 annex 1, implemented 0000 UTC 1 Dec 1998, with precautionary area 'Off Port Klang'. Segment of the Malacca-Singapore routeing system.
vts: Scheme spans c. 03°02'.7N to 02°41'N (Circ.44). On the STRAITREP chartlet the Sector 1 (Angsa)/Sector 2 (Jugra) boundary runs at about 02°52'N towards Port Klang, so the scheme lies in Sectors 1 and 2, both 'Klang VTS' (MSC.73(69) para 3.4); VHF 66 (Sector 1) and 88 (Sector 2).
reporting: STRAITREP (MSC.73(69), in force 1 Dec 1998) applies throughout the operational area, which 'includes the routeing system in the Straits of Malacca and Singapore'; reports to the VTS authority for the sector. Sectors 1-2: Klang VTS.

official_name: Malacca to Iyu Kecil (with precautionary area 'Off Sultan Shoal Lighthouse')

tss_identity: Confirmed

New scheme adopted by MSC 69; COLREG.2/Circ.44 annex 4, implemented 1 Dec 1998, with precautionary area 'Off Sultan Shoal Lighthouse'. Continues eastward into 'In the Singapore Strait' (amended 2004, COLREG.2/Circ.54 annex 5, implemented 1 Jan 2005).
vts: Scheme runs c. 02°05'N 102°04'E to 01°09'-01°14'N 103°27'-103°30'E. On the chartlets it crosses Sectors 4 (Undan) and 5 (Segenting) of Klang VTS (VHF 61, 88) and Sector 6 (Piai) of Johor VTS (VHF 88). Its eastern end meets the Tg Piai - Pulau Karimun Kecil line (reporting line, and Sector 6/7 boundary on Appendix 2); by the Circ.44 coordinates the easternmost lane ends lie marginally east of that line, in Sector 7 (Singapore VTS, VHF 73), where the associated Off Sultan Shoal precautionary area also lies. North-western end adjoins the Sector 3/4 boundary.
reporting: STRAITREP (MSC.73(69), in force 1 Dec 1998) applies throughout the operational area, which 'includes the routeing system in the Straits of Malacca and Singapore'; reports to the VTS authority for the sector. Sectors 4-5 Klang VTS, Sector 6 Johor VTS; ships crossing the Tg Piai - Karimun Kecil line report on entering Singapore VTS Sector 7.

tss_identity: Confirmed

Existence and current use confirmed by Guangzhou MSA (S13) as part of the Pearl River Estuary routeing system (珠江口水域船舶定线制), comprising two traffic lanes, two separation zones, an inshore traffic zone and two precautionary areas. IMO adoption (COLREG.2/Circ.71, 25 May 2018, implemented 1 December 2018) is lead only: circular would not load.
vts: Guangzhou VTS Centre (广州海事局船舶交通管理中心, Pearl River Estuary VTS)

Guangzhou MSA illustrates the TSS with a Guangzhou MSA VTS radar screenshot and directs ships in the TSS to seek assistance from 广州交管中心 on VHF 08/09 (S13). News report (lead) says a 'Dangan' monitoring station began trial operation on 8 April 2026 to bring the TSS under routine VTS control (S14).
reporting: Pearl River Estuary VTS has 21 reporting lines (S15) but no source places a reporting line or separate SRS on the Dangan TSS.
